notes: Your organisation's name is your own. A company used to show "MoRaj" in the sidebar with "MO" as its monogram until somebody typed a name over it, because the short name is seeded with the vendor's. Until a company names itself the app now shows a neutral monogram and "Untitled company", and once named it shows that name and nothing else. This is the rule the app already followed on your documents, applied to the screen: no MoRaj name and no MoRaj mark ever stands where yours belongs — a payment voucher, an invoice, a payslip and a GRA return have always carried your institution's crest alone, and now so does the sidebar you look at all day. Smaller, in the same pass: the setup wizard names this edition correctly, and the letter the wordmark picks out takes its colour from this edition's own mark. Nothing about your books changed: no migration, no posting rule, no report, no figure.
